critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/admin/autonomous-engine/status returns engine config + aggregates plus a nested gate_lock, but does NOT surface the latest_run details at the top level (no top-level 'status' / 'final_output'). Consumers must read status.gate_lock.latest_run_output — this is fine functionally but may confuse callers who expect run status at top level. Consider adding a top-level 'latest_run' alias for symmetry.

Historical aggregates in /status show pass_count=2 vs fail_count=3977 (0% pass_rate) — the DB retains all past FAIL runs from before the 7-gate fixes. Not a bug, but consider a retention policy or a filter cutoff so pass_rate reflects the post-fix window (e.g. last 24h/7d).
gate-lock schema is clean and self-contained (gate_open/has_recent_pass/minutes_since_last_pass/latest_run_status/latest_run_output) — good design.
